message_2:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Ng <claire@amianda.co.nz>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@amianda.co.nz>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 20:18:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Monday at 10:00am (NZDT)

Hi Claire — thanks for sending the agenda. Quick heads up: New Zealand has its DST rollback on Sunday overnight (Apr 4 -> Apr 5) and that creates a tricky overlap window for our US/EU stakeholders who are also joining the thread.

Specifically: the 10:00am NZDT slot will be 6:00pm UTC / 11:00am ET on Monday under current offsets, but because of the DST transition some attendees in APAC/ANZ may see the calendar event shift if clients have old cached TZ data — we've seen calendar invites flip an hour for a subset of enterprise customers across the cutover. That has caused missed joins in the past.

Options that I propose (ranked):
1) Move the session 1 hour earlier in NZ (09:00 NZDT) — keeps overlap-friendly times for EU/US and reduces confusion.
2) Keep the current time and we run two short back-to-back sessions (APAC-focused + async recording for US).
3) Keep as-is but I'll create a separate calendar with explicit UTC times and call-out in the invite body (not ideal).

Monica (SE) and Lauren (AM) are copied — Monica can run the demo if the earlier slot works; Lauren will help coordinate follow-up for EMEA.

I can update the invite and resend once you confirm preferred option. Apologies for the awkward timing — DST windows are always fun.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
